poll_interval.description: Polling interval for querying registered mesh peer nodes.

discovery_enabled.description: Automatically discover m3tal-mesh-node daemons via mDNS on local subnet.

peer_timeout_sec.description: Seconds before marking a non-responding peer as offline.

pairing_token.description: Shared secret used to authenticate remote mesh nodes.

require_pairing_token.description: Require pairing token/secret for remote node authentication. Disabling this removes token requirement and makes pairing optional (⚠️ SAFETY WARNING: Not recommended or safe on untrusted networks).

listen_port.description: Default telemetry port for remote mesh nodes.

default_password.description: Optional fallback password sent to remote nodes that require password verification.
